purpose: Pre-sign gate for one EIP-3009 (ERC-3009, Draft) transferWithAuthorization or receiveWithAuthorization intent, decided against a caller-declared spend policy and a caller-pasted authorization ledger. Returns exactly one decision: SPEND (within the declared policy), DENY (outside the declared policy: structural authorization defects, signer mismatch, disallowed domain, zero or replayed nonce, invalid or expired validity window, denied or unlisted payee, missing receive-variant contract), OVER_LIMIT (per-transaction cap, window cap or velocity count exceeded, or a same-economics duplicate inside the declared duplicate window), or INDETERMINATE (the policy does not declare enough to decide, for example no per-transaction cap or no window caps, or a domain without verifying_contract or chain_id so the nonce-replay rule cannot run). SPEND requires the nonce-replay rule to have been evaluated. DENY outranks OVER_LIMIT, every failing rule is listed, and the first failing rule in the fixed thirteen-rule order is primary. Rules that cannot run because their policy input is absent are reported as not evaluated rather than guessed. Arithmetic is pure decimal-string uint256 with fixed scan bounds. Counting follows the ruled classes: settled entries count toward window totals from their signed_at, signed-unexpired entries count regardless of age, canceled entries never count in sums but still match the nonce-replay check. Zero network calls, no signature recovery, no digest recomputation, no chain reads: the nonce check runs against the pasted ledger only, and on-chain nonce uniqueness is enforced by the token contract at settlement time. SPEND means within the declared policy; it is not an authorization to move funds and is not proof that funds moved.
